Game Overview

Immune System Command is a action title where dive into the microscopic world of Immune System Command, where adrenaline-fueled clicker mechanics let you battle swarming pathogens. Tap swiftly to obliterate bacteria and viruses, increase your power and fortify defenses. Immerse yourself in epic battles and strategize to keep your host body healthy.
